mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 115 index points indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 115, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained three-month increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction falling below 1400 thousand units signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 110 index points signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
